earlyBlight.name: Potato Early Blight
symptoms: Dark brown or black necrotic spots exhibiting distinct concentric circular rings (target-board pattern).
Chlorotic yellowing around lesions caused by fungal alternaric acid toxins.
Symptoms originate on mature foliage in lower canopy and progressively climb upward.

treatments.title: Targeted Pruning
treatments.detail: Prune heavily infected lower leaves and discard far from cultivation beds to halt airborne conidia.

treatments.title: Canopy Moisture Control
treatments.detail: Avoid late-afternoon overhead sprinkler irrigation to keep foliar surfaces dry throughout the night.

earlyBlight.chemicalSolution: Protective Fungicide: Mancozeb 80% WP (2-3 g/L) or Chlorothalonil 75% WP.
earlyBlight.organicSolution: Neem seed extract biopesticide or Trichoderma harzianum soil-foliar formulations.

lateBlight.name: Late Blight Foliar & Tuber Rot
symptoms: Water-soaked, grayish-green lesions rapidly expanding into dark purplish-brown necrosis.
Fine white downy mildew sporulation on the underside of leaves during cool, foggy conditions.
Lesions travel rapidly along petioles, stems, and wash into soil causing severe tuber rot.

treatments.title: Strict Quarantine & Sanitization
treatments.detail: Immediately rogue and incinerate heavily infected plants. Never compost infected foliage!

treatments.title: Bed & Ridge Protection
treatments.detail: Increase ridge soil hilling around stem bases to prevent zoospore rain-wash into underground tubers.

lateBlight.chemicalSolution: Systemic Fungicide: Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb, Dimethomorph, or Cymoxanil.
lateBlight.organicSolution: Measured Bordeaux mixture (copper sulfate + hydrated lime) preventive sprays.

healthy.name: Optimal & Disease-Free Foliage
symptoms: Uniformly vibrant deep green leaf surfaces with no chlorosis, necrosis, or water lesions.
Strong vascular leaf veins, supple elasticity, and robust flowering canopy development.
Maximized photosynthetic output promoting Grade-A tuber bulking in root beds.

treatments.title: Balanced Nutrition
treatments.detail: Maintain optimal Potassium (K) and Phosphorus (P) ratios to reinforce cell walls against fungal penetration.

treatments.title: Routine Field Inspection
treatments.detail: Conduct Potadi visual scans every 3 days during high-rainfall periods in highland terrain.

healthy.chemicalSolution: No curative fungicides required. Apply preventive contact copper spray prior to continuous rain.
healthy.organicSolution: Liquid organic bio-fertilizer and mycorrhizal inoculants for root immunity reinforcement.
